name: NodeFlow
description: Operate a running NodeFlow process-flow canvas: create/edit nodes, connect edges, assign participants & stages, arrange, assert and screenshot the graph.
description_zh: 操作正在运行的 NodeFlow 流程画布:创建/编辑节点、连接关系、分配参与方与阶段、自动排列、验证图形与截图。
description_en: Operate a running NodeFlow process-flow canvas: create/edit nodes, connect edges, assign participants & stages, arrange, assert and screenshot the graph.
examples_zh: 把 NodeFlow 里新建一个"开始"节点
把两个节点连起来并自动排列
查一下当前画布上有哪些节点和参与方
examples_en: Connect two nodes and arrange them
List nodes and participants currently on the canvas
Take a screenshot of the current flow
